title: record-browser/v1 model
description: Authoring aid for tui-json/v1 models with profile record-browser/v1. Go validation in tuic is authoritative. This schema cannot express: unique field ids; that identity, summary and details name declared fields; the layout relations wideWidth >= narrowWidth, wideHeight >= narrowHeight and listWidth <= wideWidth - 9; duplicate JSON keys; trailing data; the 32 KiB size limit and the nesting limit; label byte lengths (maxLength counts characters, which are never fewer than bytes, so a long multibyte label can pass here and fail in Go); and that numbers must be written as integers (2.4e1 and 24.0 pass here and fail in Go).

fields.description: 1 to 16 string fields with display labels. Ids must be unique (Go checks).

identity.description: Id of the declared field that holds the stable, nonempty record identity.

summary.description: Id of the declared field shown as the list label.

details.description: 1 to 16 unique declared field ids, in display order.

layout.description: Breakpoints in terminal cells. Go also requires wideWidth >= narrowWidth, wideHeight >= narrowHeight and listWidth <= wideWidth - 9.

detailText.description: Optional. clip (default) shows one cut row per field; wrap wraps values to the pane width.

embed.description: Optional. standalone (default) owns the terminal; hosted draws only a body for a host application's page, never quits and draws no title or footer.

detailSpacing.description: Optional. compact (default) shows detail fields on consecutive rows; spaced puts one blank row between consecutive fields.

emit.description: Optional. module (default) writes a standalone module; package writes only the Go files of a package with the given name. package is required in package mode and refused in module mode.

identifier.description: Exported ASCII identifier of 1 to 48 characters.

label.description: Plain text, 1 to 120 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters and no U+2028 or U+2029. Blank text is allowed. maxLength counts characters, so the byte limit is checked only by Go.
